regulation: SDWA sec. 1433 Risk & Resilience Assessment (C-WATER-R01)

applies_at_this_tier: Yes (Regional, Lakes, and Ridge Systems: 3 PWSIDs serving more than 3,300 persons)
current_state: RRAs on file for all 3 covered systems: Regional (review certified 2025-03-24), Lakes (2025-12-17), Ridge (2026-06-24). The 8 small systems are not required to certify (300i-2(e) is EPA guidance only) but use the same method voluntarily
